ports: the maker's 'PORTS & CONNECTIVITY' block, filed as its complete list: hdmi 1, usb_a 3, ethernet 1. usb_a is our mapping of the maker's 'USB 3.1 Gen 1 ports' (no plug type named), per the coordinator ruling of 2026-11-01. Not in that block and therefore not filed: the power inlet (a 'power cord' is in the box contents) and the Storage Expansion Card slot (FAQ: 'expand available custom storage via the Storage Expansion Card').
